Russia Strikes Ukraine Capital with Missiles and Drones, Wounding Five

Russian forces launched a missile and drone attack on the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv, causing widespread damage and injuring at least five people. The attack comes amid escalating tensions between Russia and Ukraine, with both sides intensifying their military operations in recent weeks.
